decision: Body = coupe: 'Infiniti G35 Full Car' (24,999,998 tris) + 'G35 Trunk' part scan (5,000,000 tris); sedan scans not used
why: Sedan folder has no full-car scan (front end / rear end / skirt states are partial and each in its own frame) so turntables/top-down are impossible; sedan bumpers globally registered onto the coupe at fitness 0.04-0.11 (they are sedan parts); brief: one body and only its own parts

decision: 'SFP Aero G35' (coupe folder) not used as a part/state
why: Registered to the full car (median 3.1 mm) but it is a partial re-scan of the same body (roof/hood/trunk missing, different wheels) - no panel that is absent from the full car, so it adds nothing to the exploded view

decision: Levelled frame from projects/huracan-evo/tools/level.py (RANSAC ground plane -> Z up, long axis -> Y); nose at -Y
why: Raw Artec frame is yawed ~30 deg and tilted 8.6 deg (ground normal 0.150,0.040,0.988); trunk part checked in the levelled frame: median 4.3 mm, 53 % overlap (inner side has no car counterpart) -> same Artec frame, no correction

decision: Trunk part kept as captured (no ICP); the car's spoiler will be cut from the full car and ride with the trunk part
why: Signed-distance map: lid surface within ~5 mm of the car everywhere except a band 30-50 mm below the car surface exactly where the aftermarket spoiler sits (the part was scanned without it). ICP's 40 mm/1.7 deg 'correction' only moved fitness 0.42->0.43 (sliding on the spoiler mismatch) so it was rejected

decision: Second levelling (tools/rake.py): pitch 3.7 deg nose-down, roll 0.65 deg, applied after ground cleanup to the car and the trunk alike; jack stands removed (tools/stands.py); every .blend prepped --like prep/frame.json
why: The scanned ground is not the car's reference: front was jacked (stand under the sill), wheel centres and arch tops in an orthographic side render show 3.6-3.9 deg nose-up; a raked car reads wrong in side profiles. One rigid transform for all scans keeps the trunk registered (lesson: pin transforms with --like)

decision: Shot plan: s1 low front-right 3/4 turntable -> s2 rear-left 3/4 orbit -> s3 front wheel ECU -> s4 headlight/fascia slide -> s5 tail lamp + spoiler -> s6 trunk opens (part scan + spoiler on the lid hinge) -> s7 up-and-over to top-down -> s8 exploded view (panels stack above the car, orbit front-right to rear-right, lock) -> logo
why: Brief/Temerario order: turntables, extreme close-ups, panels open (only the trunk has a part scan on the coupe), top-down, exploded, logo. Non-beat-critical shots rendered long (5.5/5/3/3/3/3.5 s) while waiting for the track; trunk + explode keyed to its beats once it arrives

decision: Licence plates flattened (tools/deplate.py: plate-plane projection within 30 mm)
why: Customer plate characters were legible in close-ups; v1 grid-snap left spiky blocks (seen in previews), plane projection leaves a smooth blank plate

decision: Exploded view panels cut from the full-car scan along seams read off orthographic renders (tools/segment.py): hood, front/rear bumper covers, both doors with mirrors; trunk = G35 Trunk part scan + spoiler cut from the car
why: The coupe has only one part scan and no '... removed' state scans; cutting at the visible panel seams is the only way to separate body panels from our own data. Checked with a colour-coded render (reg/seg_sheet.jpg)
